# OpusClip Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.

A Muse agent skill that turns long-form videos into short, captioned, vertical clips with OpusClip's API: create a clip project from a video URL, check the project's render status, and list the resulting clips with their virality scores. Rendering is async and metered per render-minute — the skill confirms before every project creation, naming the video URL. Honest note: API access requires a Pro-tier (or higher) OpusClip plan and the API is in beta; clip download URLs are time-limited, so download promptly. Draft: written from OpusClip's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
